gyomyo.name: 교묘 (Gyomyo, 'the crazy cat')
gyomyo.desc: A chubby tabby cat with three stripes on the forehead, big oval eyes, tongue poking out of a cat smile, an x-shaped belly button, short legs and a curly tail. Obsessed with trading cards — crazy about opening packs and checking card prices.

jangnan.name: 장난이곰 (Jangnani Bear)
jangnan.desc: A big round sitting bear with small round ears, a sleepy deadpan face, tiny eyes and a small nose, a huge soft belly and big feet. Loves toys, die-cast minicars and figures.

pengson.name: 펭슨 황 (Pengson Hwang)
pengson.desc: An egg-shaped penguin with a solid black crayon-shaded body, a big white face, curly eyelashes on round eyes, a small diamond-shaped beak outlined in black, and tiny white feet. A tech geek whose motto is 'You don't buy a graphics card, you serve it.'
